title: B.Sc Mathematics Honours Syllabus (FYUGP NEP-2020)
description: Complete Four Year Undergraduate Program (FYUGP) syllabus for Mathematics under NEP-2020. Includes course outcomes, detailed topic breakdown (Calculus, Algebra, Real Analysis, Differential Equations, Topology, etc.) and list of recommended textbooks.
modules: Sem 3: MJ-3 (Abstract Algebra - I), MN-1 (Introductory Mathematics)
Sem 5: MJ-6 (Real Analysis - II), MJ-7 (Linear Algebra)

title: B.Sc Physics Honours Syllabus (FYUGP NEP-2020)
description: Standard Kolhan University NEP Physics Honours Syllabus containing theoretical and practical schedules for Mechanics, Electricity & Magnetism, Waves & Optics, Thermodynamics, Quantum Mechanics, and Solid State Physics.
modules: Sem 5: MJ-6 (Quantum Mechanics), MJ-7 (Solid State Physics)

title: B.Sc Chemistry Honours Syllabus (FYUGP NEP-2020)
description: FYUGP syllabus for Chemistry Honours. Covers Inorganic, Organic, Physical, and Analytical Chemistry, complete with laboratory experiments and safety guidelines.

title: B.Com Honours Syllabus (FYUGP NEP-2020)
description: Detailed syllabus for Bachelor of Commerce (Honours). Includes detailed guidelines for Financial Accounting, Business Law, Corporate Accounting, Income Tax, Management Accounting, and Auditing.
modules: Sem 4: MJ-4 (Income Tax Law & Practice), MJ-5 (Business Mathematics)
Sem 6: MJ-8 (Auditing & Corporate Governance), MJ-9 (Financial Management)

title: B.A History Honours Syllabus (FYUGP NEP-2020)
description: Kolhan University Bachelor of Arts History Honours FYUGP curriculum. Spans Ancient Indian History, Medieval Europe, Modern India, and World History.
modules: Sem 1: MJ-1 (Idea of Bharat & Ancient Indian History)
Sem 2: MJ-2 (Social Formations & Cultural Patterns of Ancient World)
Sem 3: MJ-3 (History of India II: c. 300 to 750 CE)
Sem 4: MJ-4 (Medieval India), MJ-5 (Rise of Modern West)
Sem 5: MJ-6 (History of India: 1750-1857), MJ-7 (Modern World)
Sem 6: MJ-8 (History of India: 1857-1947), MJ-9 (Contemporary India)

title: B.A Political Science Syllabus (FYUGP)
description: FYUGP syllabus for Political Science Honours. Covers political theories, comparative government, public administration, international relations, and Indian political thought.
modules: Sem 2: MJ-2 (Constitutional Government and Democracy in India)
Sem 3: MJ-3 (Political Theory: Concepts and Debates)
Sem 4: MJ-4 (Comparative Government & Politics), MJ-5 (Public Administration)
Sem 5: MJ-6 (International Relations), MJ-7 (Western Political Thought)
Sem 6: MJ-8 (Indian Political Thought), MJ-9 (Public Policy in India)
